module: Flowgraph node "Parking System Parameters" (once_instant). Sets the parking system (gameplay_parking.setParkingVars): precision and neatness (clamped 0-1), radiusCoef, respawnProbability (baseProbability), poolActiveAmount (activeAmount; with data.usePoolInactiveAmount, equals the number of parked cars minus the value), debugLevel (0 to 3). Only non-nil pins are applied.

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

workOnce.desc: Builds the variables table from the non-nil pins and sends it to gameplay_parking.setParkingVars; sets gameplay_parking.debugLevel.
